cases.finding: Scriptw composes the admitted 10000-step recurrence once; Scriptc final Wasm keeps 1250 eight-step iterations. Residual whole-entry cost is not missing arithmetic composition.
Scriptw uses checked seed+149995000; Scriptc keeps five source-ordered terms per loop. Scriptw still creates its Realm/global/activation and observes output.

Both retain construction loops and live method checks. Scriptw's successful fixed-push path avoids argv; it still repeats literal-key lookup and prototype checks. Scriptc still boxes the String reference and dispatches a cached native append.

Scriptc final Wasm uses a mask/branch table for the modulo selection. Scriptw retains three guarded Number remainder sites plus generic fallbacks; widening the parked append argument proof is separate work.

Scriptw already borrows packed NumberBits for a four-step ordered checksum and scalar tail. Scriptc retains dynamic checksum operations and boxing. Construction and actual sort helpers remain separate costs.
